name: uirizz
role: Hermes plugin rendering A2UI v1.0 cards in chat (a2ui_render); typed-yes approvals, hash-chained audit

tree.doc: uirizz Python package: A2UI admission, store, and tool handlers.

docs.title: uirizz: review and improvement plan (23 Nov 2026)

module_docs.__init__.py: Hermes plugin entrypoint for uirizz. Registers the bundled skill, hook, and tool.
module_docs.dashboard/plugin_api.py: Dashboard REST router exposing stored surfaces for live card refresh.
module_docs.evals/harness.py: Authoring eval harness for A2UI golden fixtures.
module_docs.scripts/bump_plugin_version.py: Rewrite only the plugin.yaml version: line. Refuse duplicate keys or a wrong name.
module_docs.scripts/measure_tokens.py: Print o200k and cl100k token counts for the skill and tool schema.
module_docs.tests/fake_ctx.py: Minimal PluginContext double for registration tests.
module_docs.tests/test_actions.py: Structured A2UI actions stay editable and inject quoted pre_llm_call context.
module_docs.tests/test_authoring_evals.py: Authoring eval harness: good fixtures admit, bad fixtures return expected codes.
module_docs.tests/test_authoring_fixes.py: Regressions found while reviewing how a model actually authors uirizz cards.
module_docs.tests/test_declared_actions.py: Declared actions: a click is bound to one exact tool call, approved once.
module_docs.tests/test_express.py: Official A2UI Express compiles to admitted v1.0 JSONL.
module_docs.tests/test_gate.py: Approval gate: a card click is a request, never approval. Fail-closed.
module_docs.tests/test_ops.py: present, update, delete, and admission failures for a2ui_render.
module_docs.tests/test_plugin_api.py: Desktop ctx.rest backend: read a stored surface for live card refresh.
module_docs.tests/test_plugin_yaml_strict.py: plugin.yaml must parse under a strict YAML loader (no duplicate keys).
module_docs.tests/test_recipes.py: Every Express block the skill teaches must compile, admit, and gate correctly.
module_docs.tests/test_register.py: Fake-ctx registration: tools, hooks, skills, and JSON-string handlers.
module_docs.tests/test_security_urls.py: Adversarial media URL tests. Reserved and private hosts are never contacted.
module_docs.tests/test_skill_guidance.py: Skill and schema must teach when-to-use, hard rules, and recovery.
module_docs.tests/test_skill_layout.py: Skill and describe/schema must teach wide A2UI layouts (RESEARCH.md §10).
module_docs.tests/test_surface_rebind.py: Express output is rebound to the stored surface_id and carries no nulls.
module_docs.tests/test_theme_contrast.py: Night Hive text colors meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) on dark surfaces.
module_docs.tests/test_tokens.py: Skill and tool schema must stay within the researched token budgets.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/__init__.py: uirizz Python package: A2UI admission, store, and tool handlers.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/actions.py: Structured A2UI user-action log. Surfaces stay editable.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/api.py: Read-only REST payload for a stored A2UI surface.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/bindings.py: Declared actions: card buttons bound to one exact Hermes tool call.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/catalog.py: Official Basic Catalog identity, allowlist, and admission caps.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/express.py: Compile official A2UI Express into camelCase v1.0 JSONL.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/gate.py: Approval gate and audit log for A2UI actions.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/hooks.py: Hook registration. Accept **kwargs. Do not register transform_llm_output.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/store.py: Surface records in the plugin data directory, keyed by surface_id.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/theme.py: Night Hive tokens. Always dark. Contrast notes are in docs/RESEARCH.md.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/tools.py: a2ui_render tool: schema, handlers, and registration.
module_docs.uirizz_plugin/validate.py: Admit A2UI v1.0 payloads against the official Basic Catalog allowlist.

symbols.name: register
symbols.doc: Called by Hermes PluginManager. Keep this fast; lazy-import heavy deps in handlers.

symbols.name: SurfaceCard
symbols.sig: { file, args, result, sessionId, fallback, ctx }

symbols.name: record_action
symbols.sig: surface_id, session_id, event, context, source_component_id, client_timestamp
symbols.doc: Store a structured action for a session. Never lock the surface.

symbols.name: surface_payload
symbols.doc: Return the stored surface as a JSON-serializable dict.

symbols.name: ActionConfigError
symbols.doc: A definition is invalid. Carries a model- and human-readable reason.

symbols.name: ParamError
symbols.doc: A click's context does not satisfy the action's params.

symbols.name: Binding
symbols.doc: A rendered, validated call for one click.

symbols.name: canonical
symbols.doc: Canonical JSON for hashing: sorted keys, no whitespace, integral floats as ints.

symbols.name: redact
symbols.doc: Display copy of args: secret-looking keys hidden, strings bounded.

symbols.name: parse_definition
symbols.doc: Validate one definition. Raises ActionConfigError with a precise reason.

symbols.name: validate_params
symbols.doc: Return typed params from a click context, or raise ParamError listing every problem.

symbols.name: bind
symbols.doc: Validate a click against the definition and render the exact call.

symbols.name: set_actions_dir
symbols.doc: Tests point the loader at a directory. Production uses the plugin data dir.

symbols.name: register_action
symbols.doc: Register a declared action from another Hermes plugin.

symbols.name: status_report
symbols.doc: Loaded actions plus every config problem, for describe and the check command.

symbols.name: surface_warnings
symbols.doc: Problems with declared-action buttons on a surface, found at present time.

symbols.name: main
symbols.doc: ``python -m uirizz_plugin.bindings check [FILE]``: validate an actions file.

symbols.name: _detail
symbols.doc: The compiler's own message (line, column, allowed enum values), sanitized.

symbols.name: _state_for
symbols.doc: Mirror the stored surface so an update can be checked against it.

symbols.name: compile_express
symbols.doc: Return camelCase A2UI v1.0 JSONL for raw or <a2ui>-wrapped Express.

symbols.name: sanitize_context
symbols.doc: Strip control characters, redact secret-looking keys, cap sizes.

symbols.name: _tri
symbols.doc: True / False for an unambiguous boolean, None when it cannot be trusted.

symbols.name: _marks
symbols.doc: Return (side-effect markers, read-only markers) found in an action context.

symbols.name: definition_contexts
symbols.doc: Contexts the stored surface itself declares for this event name.

symbols.name: classify
symbols.doc: Return (requires_confirmation, reason). Fail-closed.

symbols.name: _append
symbols.doc: Append one chained entry. Cross-process safe on POSIX.

symbols.name: read_entries
symbols.doc: All parseable entries, oldest first. Raises GateError if the log is unreadable.

symbols.name: verify_chain
symbols.doc: Check the hash chain of the current log file.

symbols.name: log_action
symbols.sig: surface_id, session_id, event, context, surface, source_component_id, client_...
symbols.doc: Record a click. Never authorizes anything. Returns the audit entry.

symbols.name: _parse_reply
symbols.doc: Return ('yes'|'no', optional code) for an explicit reply, else None.

symbols.name: observe_user_message
symbols.doc: Resolve pending actions from the user's typed chat reply. Returns decisions made.

symbols.name: complete_action
symbols.doc: Record the outcome of an action. 'done' needs a live user approval.

symbols.name: _binding_view
symbols.doc: What a card or the audit view may show: no raw secret-looking values.

symbols.name: gate_notice
symbols.doc: Text for the model about actions that need, or just got, a decision.

symbols.name: tool_block_message
symbols.doc: A veto message if the gate forbids this tool call right now, else None.

symbols.name: record_tool_result
symbols.sig: session_id, tool_name, args, tool_call_id, status, error_type, has_args
symbols.doc: post_tool_call: close the bound call that pre_tool_call let through.

symbols.name: pre_llm_call
symbols.doc: Inject structured user-action context for the current session only.

symbols.name: pre_tool_call
symbols.doc: Veto tools while a card action waits for the user's explicit yes.

symbols.name: post_tool_call
symbols.doc: Record the outcome of a declared action's bound call. Observer only.

symbols.name: set_store_dir
symbols.doc: Tests inject a temporary directory. Production uses plugin data APIs.

symbols.name: describe_topic
symbols.doc: Return a bundled reference file, so the model never depends on skill_view paths.

symbols.name: parse_tool_result
symbols.doc: Parse the JSON object at the start of a tool result, ignoring a trailing MEDIA line.

symbols.name: _rebind
symbols.doc: Point every envelope at the stored surface_id.

symbols.name: handle_a2ui_render
symbols.doc: Registered handler. Always returns a json.dumps string.

symbols.name: register_tools
symbols.doc: Register tools. Names must match plugin.yaml provides_tools.

symbols.name: is_public_ip
symbols.doc: Return True only if the address is safe to contact as a public HTTPS origin.

symbols.name: validate_https_public_url
symbols.doc: Admit a URL for later host-side load. Does not open a connection.

symbols.name: follow_and_validate
symbols.doc: Validate url, then every redirect hop, without using ambient proxies.
